events.name: STRATIFICATION_UPDATED
events.description: The stratification state after each learner action — a composed listener (readout, grader) can subscribe; a harmless no-op when the atom runs standalone.
events.synonyms: stratification update, generation step, mobility change, Gini index, class shares

events.name: MODE_SELECTED
events.description: Lab router broadcast naming the active mode; this instrument renders when the mode equals matchMode, otherwise renders null.

events.name: STEP_GENERATION
events.description: Learner pressed Step One Generation to advance the stratification simulation by one generation.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bar Height
overridableConfigKeys.description: Height of the stacked bar, in pixels.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Bar Margin
overridableConfigKeys.description: Horizontal margin, in pixels, on each side of the stacked bar.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Concentration Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fraction of an inner stratum's (upper-middle/working) share pulled outward to the adjacent extreme stratum per generation, scaled by (1 - mobility/100) — the low-mobility 'rich stay rich, poor stay poor' term. Keep this and Mobility Rate each ≤ 1.0 so shares always stay non-negative.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: social mobility, intergenerational mobility, mobility index, class mobility, income inequality

overridableConfigKeys.label: Income Weights
overridableConfigKeys.description: Relative income multiplier for each of the five strata, index-aligned with Strata (same order: richest to poorest). Used with the current shares to compute the Gini-style inequality index: income_i = share_i × weight_i, normalized into income shares, then the discrete Gini formula over cumulative population vs. cumulative income (poorest to richest).
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: income distribution, income inequality, Gini index, Gini coefficient, wealth gap, economic inequality

overridableConfigKeys.label: Initial Mobility Index
overridableConfigKeys.description: Starting value (0-100) of the mobility index.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: social mobility, intergenerational mobility, mobility index, class mobility

overridableConfigKeys.label: Interactive
overridableConfigKeys.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Match Mode
overridableConfigKeys.description: When composed behind a lab router, the MODE_SELECTED mode value this instrument responds to. Empty string means standalone — render immediately on INIT.

overridableConfigKeys.label: Mobility Rate
overridableConfigKeys.description: Fraction of a non-middle stratum's share that migrates one step toward the middle class per generation, scaled by the mobility index (mobilityFrac = mobility/100). Keep this and Concentration Rate each ≤ 1.0 so shares always stay non-negative.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: social mobility, intergenerational mobility, mobility index, class mobility

overridableConfigKeys.label: Strata
overridableConfigKeys.description: The five class strata, richest to poorest, each with its starting population share (must sum to 100) and bar color. Drives the stacked bar; the mobility transition and Gini index are computed over these five shares in fixed order.
overridableConfigKeys.synonyms: social class, class strata, class structure, upper class, upper-middle class, middle class, working class, lower class, socioeconomic status

overridableConfigKeys.label: Stratum Text Color
overridableConfigKeys.description: Color of the percent labels drawn on top of each bar segment.
